finding: --desky (seqsubsky on the sky flat's RAW source frames) inverted the flat's edge vignetting and cost 31x in background flatness. Shipped 2026-07-29 (f170540), reverted to OFF-by-default 2026-08-04.
mechanism: seqsubsky is a BACKGROUND EXTRACTION operator, defined on a flat-fielded image. The flat builder ran it on raw frames still carrying vignetting: the frame is sky x V, not sky. Fitting an additive plane to that product and subtracting it overshoots where V curves hardest — the frame edge — and drives the local left-right asymmetry through zero and out the other side.
instrument: scripts/qa/regional_stat.py (Siril stat), MEDIANS. dipoleX = ((TR+BR)-(TL+BL))/2 on corner medians normalised to the 4-corner mean at that radius; 0 = left-right symmetric.

source_domain_edge_dipoleX._note: the decisive measurement: what the flat SHOULD look like vs what --desky made it
source_domain_edge_dipoleX.reading: the raw lights carry a genuine right-bright edge asymmetry (real optical vignetting; the dark is clean). The pre---desky flat captured it, same sign, ~85% of magnitude — dividing by it REMOVED most of the asymmetry. Every --desky flat has the OPPOSITE sign, so dividing by it roughly DOUBLES it.

three_arm_product_comparison._frames: july31/set-01, 500 frames after the ratified 7-frame cull, identical in all arms

why_no_guard_caught_it: f170540's own validation used a whole-frame odd-PLANE fit, a centre-vs-corner RADIAL ratio, PRNU correlation and mote depth. None can see a left-right sign flip localised at the edge: the radial ratio averages all four corners, PRNU and motes are high-frequency.
Worse, the cited proof of success is consistent with the defect: a partial sign inversion makes a whole-frame plane fit CANCEL, so 'odd plane -59% and -69%' is what the regression itself produces.
The commit measured a degradation (level spread 2.48% -> 3.10%) and shipped it as an accepted trade. On july31 the real figure is 12.4% vs 0.4%.

baseline.json / the no-regression harness has NEVER been built (0 found in repo). The three guards that exist (check_bitdepth, check_calibrate, check_stack_rejection) all verify WIRING, not product. A change that corrupts data while leaving wiring intact passes all three.
